function.name: calculate_slope_gradient
function.description: Calculate the slope gradient between two geographical coordinates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

point1.description: The geographic coordinates for the first point [Latitude, Longitude].

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t compute a slope gradient from just latitude/longitude coordinates.  
A slope (or grade) is defined as the ratio of vertical change (elevation difference) to horizontal distance.  
With only the two geographic points you’ve supplied, we have no information about how high or low each point is relative to sea level (or to each other).  

If you can provide the elevations (in meters, feet, etc.) for both locations, I can calculate the slope gradient in degrees, percent, or ratio for you.
